ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) base pixels with high-intensity (white) localized pixel clusters resulting in high local contrast but low global brightness.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark pigmentation across the entire ventral surface; high-contrast white pixels are distributed as disorganized linear streaks and small circular clusters across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a deep pixel-depth relative to the lobe width; vertex is sharply defined.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and asymmetrical; left lobe trailing edge contains a significant macro-scale concave indentation; right lobe trailing edge presents micro-serrations and high-relief protrusions (barnacle clusters) at the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep from the tips toward the median notch; the trailing edge boundary is non-linear due to extensive structural irregularities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible clusters of high-intensity circular marks concentrated on the distal tips (consistent with barnacle attachment) and scattered small ring-like formations across the medial lobe surfaces.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of unaligned, high-intensity white linear streaks (rake marks) of varying lengths and widths across the majority of the visible ventral area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large semi-circular indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe suggesting significant tissue loss; prominent clusters of biological encrustations on the distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive crisscrossing pattern of linear scars concentrated at the fluke-to-peduncle transition zone.
